payload.rationale: Deployment recommendations-api has replicas set to 2 and enforces required hostname-level pod anti-affinity (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution on kubernetes.io/hostname). Because the cluster only contains a single node (vm-2), the second replica cannot be scheduled and remains in Pending phase. Converting the required pod anti-affinity to preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution allows the second replica to schedule on vm-2 while preserving affinity preferences when more nodes exist.
payload.rollback_trigger: Revert if pod scheduling continues to fail, deployment fails to progress, or error rate exceeds 0.001 / p95 latency exceeds 200ms.
